gotchas_discovered.lesson: Configuration changes outside feature branches accumulate and must be periodically consolidated

gotchas_discovered.lesson: Local branch advancement tracking is critical before push operations

gotchas_discovered.description: Consolidating 5 feature branches with multiple commits each creates complex merge history
